external_games.name: The Quest for the Golden Flece

name: The Quest for the Golden Flece
storyline: You set sail on a perilous journey aboard the ship Argonauts, accompanied by a diverse crew of brave heroes. Together, you’ll navigate treacherous seas, face mythical creatures, and solve the riddles of ancient civilizations in search of the legendary Golden Fleece.
summary: The programme will let the player feel what the quest for the Golden Fleece was all about! While playing the game, you can learn to concoct the Soporific, a magic sleep-inducing potion, enter a wind-ball throwing battle or go on a fascinating cruise. It is also worthwhile to prove oneself as the general commanding the team of the Argonauts. The chill of the excitement, the gooseflesh from the exhilaration, the spikes of adrenaline and the explosions... of laughter - guaranteed!
